shellCommands.command: cat package.json; git status --short; git branch -a; git log --oneline | head -5; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.next -prune -o -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -100; cat next.config.* 2>/dev/null
for f in app/*.tsx app/*/page.tsx tsconfig.json; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done; git diff; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/ 2>&1 | head; cat node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"'
cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app; grep -n -A12 "| Profile" 03-api-reference/04-functions/cacheLife.md | head -30; grep -rn "cookies" 02-guides/migrating-to-cache-components.md | head
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -40; echo EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; grep -rn "instant\|dynamic =\|revalidate =\|dynamicIO" app next.config.ts

(npx next start -p 3456 >/tmp/start.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; curl -s -H 'Cookie: draft-title=Hello%20Draft' localhost:3456/preview | grep -o 'Hello Draft' | head -1; curl -s localhost:3456/preview | grep -o 'Untitled draft' | head -1; curl -sI localhost:3456/news | grep -i cache-control; pkill -f "next start" ; git status --short
